question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **General**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **General **means applicable or relevant to a whole class or group, rather than specific individuals.
 
• In the given context, 'general' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Grammatically, 'general' is an adjective that modifies the noun 'blank'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exclusive** means restricted or limited to a specific group or individual.
 
• **Literate **means being able to read and write.
 
• **Unusual **means not common or typical.
